purpose: Append-only registry for THC Encyclopedia material beyond the protected THC-ENC-001 through THC-ENC-420 core.
rules: THC-ENC-001 through THC-ENC-420 remain protected by the controlled core registry.
New encyclopedia lessons start at THC-ENC-421 and use monotonically increasing permanent IDs.
Each extension entry must have a unique number, part, title, primaryFormat, and teachingVisual.
Adding an entry here does not publish it; a matching canonical lesson source and publication batch are still required.
Search and validation consume the core and extension registries together.
